##**AWARDS!!!**

Everyone likes awards, so why don't we do some. I have a few that I thought of myself, but anyone that wants to chime in please do so.

#**From Rags to Riches:**

This award is given to an unranked team that received the highest rank. Said team does not have to have finished the season the highest, just reached the highest point. This season's Rags to Riches winners are the ... **Iowa Hawkeyes!**

#**Just the Tip:**

The Just the Tip Award is given to teams having appeared in the Top 25 just once. Ranked once, but not the whole time. Teams receiving Just the Tip this season are the ...

* **Arizona State Sun Devils!**

* **West Virginia Mountaineers!**

* **Western Kentucky Hilltoppers!**

#**In-N-Out:**

Everyone loves a good In-N-Out Burger, but not in v/CFB. The In-N-Out is awarded to the team that entered *and* exited the poll the most. The team that couldn't decide whether or not they wanted to be in the poll is the ... **Mississippi State Bulldogs!**

#**Photo Finish:**

This award is given to a team that was unranked all season long, but at the very last chance, receiving a ranking in the final poll. Our photo finishers for the 2015 season are the ... **Western Kentucky Hilltoppers!**

#**USC Participation:**

We all know that preseason rankings are a good show of how the season is going to unfold (See 2012 USC Trojans). This award is given to the highest ranked Preseason team to fall completely out of the poll by the end of the season. The 2015 USC Participation winners are the ... **Auburn Tigers!*

#**Underachiever:**

Sometimes you finish better than your preseason rank, sometimes you finish worse. A very special few can say that they finished the season with the same rank they received Preseason. The Underachievers for 2015 are the ... **Michigan State Spartans!**

#**Shithead(s) of the Season:**

Those of you who paid attention to our poll all season know that those who did not submit their poll by the deadline made my own personal "Shitlist." Don't worry, each Voater starts the season with a clean slate. However, the users to make my Shitlist the most receive the Honorary Shithead of the Season Award. * @hi5enigma

Another section in our poll is the "Noteworthy Votes" under our actual poll. Here, users voting for teams significantly outside their averages, being the first to vote for a team, or even completely leaving a team out of their ballot are called out for their votes. The Note-worthiest Voater is the Voater that appeared in our Noteworthy Votes section the most. It is my pleasure to recognize @loltidderfcuf as our 2015 Note-worthiest Voater.
